      <title>Lewis Hamilton visits Egypt’s Rafah crossing and Gaza aid facilities</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/10/lewis-hamilton-egypt-rafah-crossing-gaza-aid-facilities</link>
      <description><p>Seven-time F1 world champion tours border area and logistics warehouses operated by Egyptian Red Crescent</p><p>Lewis Hamilton has visited Egypt’s Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip to meet organisations sending humanitarian aid to the territory.</p><p>The seven-time Formula One world champion has spoken out about conflict and humanitarian crises in the region, and has called for peace. He has frequently posted on social media about children killed in Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and called for a ceasefire.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/10/lewis-hamilton-egypt-rafah-crossing-gaza-aid-facilities">Continue reading...</a></description>

    <item>
      <title>Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision</link>
      <description><p>President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo</p><p>Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.</p><p>The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/08/african-philosophies-see-my-world-film-festival-manchester</link>
      <description><p>See My World, an event highlighting the pan-African thought via film, poetry and dance, builds on momentum sparked by local activists and creatives</p><p>African philosophies including exploring how lessons from the past can shape the present and near future have inspired a film festival coming to Manchester.</p><p><a href="https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/see-my-world-film-festival-tickets-2000609164867">See My World</a>, a day dedicated to independent creators from across the African diaspora in the north of England, will take place at the Contact theatre on 21 November.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/08/african-philosophies-see-my-world-film-festival-manchester">Continue reading...</a></description>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/uk/manchester">Manchester</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/culture/culture">Culture</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/film/film">Film</category>

      <title>Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:50:21 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category></category><title>Africa: Ghana waste dump poses health, environmental 'crisis'</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/africa-ghana-waste-dump-poses-health-environmental-crisis</link><description>
An acrid haze hung over a sprawling dump in Ghana's capital, Accra, as excavators gouged into mounds of smouldering rubbish. Thin plumes of black smoke curled from burning plastic and rubber, mingling with the rank odour of stagnant lagoon water.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/75aca4fa-ddb3-11f1-9181-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261111-102346-102540-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/75aca4fa-ddb3-11f1-9181-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261111-102346-102540-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">7f1500e6-ddb3-11f1-bc3d-89283ce67561</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:46:14 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>UK authorities arrests US soldier suspected of spying for Russia</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/uk-authorities-arrests-us-soldier-suspected-of-spying-for-russia</link><description>
A member of the US army suspected of spying for Russia was arrested in Britain on Tuesday, London police said, following an investigation with support from the American military and law enforcement.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/19b8116e-ddb0-11f1-9db5-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261111-080643-080817-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/19b8116e-ddb0-11f1-9db5-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261111-080643-080817-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2338c21a-ddb0-11f1-97dc-21d1d5ea5b39</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:41:06 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Sports</category><title>Football: Éli Junior Kroupi earns first France call-up from Zinédine Zidane</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/sports/20261111-football-%C3%A9li-junior-kroupi-earns-first-france-call-up-from-zin%C3%A9dine-zidane</link><description>
Bournemouth centre-forward Éli Junior Kroupi has earned his first call-up to the French national team. He replaces Marcus Thuram, who is injured and has been returned to his club Inter Milan.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/208b3bee-dd72-11f1-87bf-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/kroupi-1.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/208b3bee-dd72-11f1-87bf-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/kroupi-1.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">aa400bda-dd72-11f1-bd2b-2bef3f196e6a</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:35:59 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>L'Equipe TV</dc:creator></item><item><category>Americas</category><title>Want to live on the moon? NASA opens recruitment for Artemis programme</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/want-to-live-moon-nasa-opens-recruitment-for-artemis-programme</link><description>
NASA is expanding its astronaut corps for the first time in two years. As the US space agency grows its Artemis programme, recruitment is in progress for a brand-new class of space explorers who will train to "live and work beyond Earth". 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6d31ad6c-dda8-11f1-bfaf-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26146646568090.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6d31ad6c-dda8-11f1-bfaf-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26146646568090.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">67860e32-dda1-11f1-b5a1-fb70a7eee328</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:42:21 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6d31ad6c-dda8-11f1-bfaf-f71d22e7fea9/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26146646568090.jpg">NASA via AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Spain’s general strike puts housing crisis at centre of upcoming elections</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261111-spain-general-strike-puts-housing-crisis-centre-upcoming-elections</link><description>
For the first time in 14 years, millions of Spanish workers are striking across the country Wednesday to demand action on a major housing crisis and the rising cost of living. The expected disruptions to public transport and the widespread closure of businesses come less than three weeks before a snap election that could bring the far right to power. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3e42ab36-dda4-11f1-9579-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-11T042126Z-330483324-RC2DLOAYE7CM-RTRMADP-3-SPAIN-STRIKE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3e42ab36-dda4-11f1-9579-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-11T042126Z-330483324-RC2DLOAYE7CM-RTRMADP-3-SPAIN-STRIKE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b18d818e-dda3-11f1-869c-372a8ce69f43</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:29:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3e42ab36-dda4-11f1-9579-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-11T042126Z-330483324-RC2DLOAYE7CM-RTRMADP-3-SPAIN-STRIKE.jpg">© Violeta Santos Moura, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Tue, 10 Nov 2026 22:09:39 +0000 en <![CDATA[ SpaceX moves Starship Flight 15 booster to launch pad for 'squeeze test' ahead of epic double-catch attempt (photos) ]]> SpaceX is one big step closer to the 15th test flight of its Starship megarocket.

The company announced today (Nov. 10) that it had moved its latest Starship first stage, known as Super Heavy Booster 22, to the launch mount at its Starbase facility in South Texas ahead of Flight 15, which is scheduled to lift off this Friday (Nov. 13).

During the upcoming launch test, SpaceX plans to catch both Booster 22 and Starship's Ship upper stage with its launch tower's "chopstick" arms in a double landing catch — something the private spaceflight company has never tried before. It will be the first full recovery of an orbital rocket in history.

Booster 22 therefore "was used for final catch testing upon arrival [at the pad], including a suspended squeeze test at catch height," SpaceX said in an X post today (Nov. 10).

That post shared four photos of the giant booster, which is powered by 33 of SpaceX's next-gen Raptor engines. The first shot showed Super Heavy in one of Starbase's "Mega Bay" assembly buildings before rollout, while the other three depicted it grasped by the tower's arms, held high in the South Texas sky.

SpaceX has used the chopstick arms during Starship flights before; it has successfully caught Super Heavy on three separate occasions. But the company has never attempted a catch of Ship, which flies higher and farther than the booster and is therefore a more challenging target. And SpaceX only reached orbit with Starship for the first time on Flight 14, which launched on Sept. 28.

So Flight 15 will break new ground. And, if all goes to plan, it will give us a look at the future: SpaceX plans to catch Super Heavy and Ship on all operational Starship missions, as this recovery strategy will allow the company to boost the megarocket's launch cadence.

And SpaceX wants to fly Starship incredibly often, so that it can build out its Starlink V3 broadband constellation and even bigger Starmind AI data-center network. Indeed, Elon Musk has said the company is eyeing 10,000 Starship flights per year by 2030.

If all goes to plan, Flight 15 will launch from Starbase on Friday during a 75-minute window that opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT; 4:45 p.m. local Texas time).

Super Heavy will return to Starbase for its catch about 6.5 minutes after liftoff. Ship will follow suit much later — about 22 hours later, in fact, after it has deployed 26 Starlink V3 spacecraft into LEO and completed 14 circuits of our planet.

You can watch all the action live here at Space.com and get updates about the mission here.

]]> <![CDATA[ Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose, and John Leguizamo reveal why they joined Andy Weir's sci-fi audio drama 'Exoplanet' (interview) ]]> In any respectable audiobook project, finding the names of Andy Weir ("The Martian," "Project Hail Mary") and Benjamin Percy ("The Ninth Metal," "Wolverine") attached would elicit intense fan interest, but add the superstar vocal talents of Anthony Mackie ("Avengers: Infinity War," "Avengers: Doomsday"), Ariana DeBose ("West Side Story"), and John Leguizamo ("Ice Age"), and it catapults this sonic odyssey into the stratosphere.

Such is the case with "Exoplanet," Audible Original’s new 7-episode science fiction audio drama executive produced by Weir and penned by Percy. Its planet-hopping space disaster narrative sees the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder hit a quantum anomaly, forcing their ship to crash-land onto a deadly exoplanet. All is not as it seems, though, as each crew member arrives in a different era on the same world.

We hooked up with Mackie, DeBose, and Lequizamo to learn more about this renaissance of audio dramas and what attracted them to board Weir's sci-fi thriller.

One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone. A sci-fi thriller executive produced by Andy Weir (#1 bestselling author of Project Hail Mary, The Martian), with an all-star cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo. 

Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.View Deal

Mackie voices Chief Engineer Jeff Shaw. His attraction to the imaginative genre began at an early age thanks to some cool family friends while growing up in the Big Easy.

"My brother went to college at Morehouse," he tells SPACE. "I was like 8, and he was 18. He’d always bring friends home, because New Orleans is a party city, so they'd come over and get drunk. But one of his friends gave me a book by Walter Mosley and one by Octavia Butler, and I got hooked into sci-fi and the future."

"From 'Back to the Future' to 'Aliens,' the future was such an idea of what was going to be out there. Now we’re living it," reveals Mackie. "It’s very important to me as a human being to have that construct as a part of my career. The only thing more arrogant than wanting to be president is standing up and saying, 'Yeah, I can go to space.' That sounds crazy to me."

Leguizamo's New York City childhood was influenced by absorbing classic radio dramas of the past, which primed him for this special Audible project.

“It was Anthony and Ariana being in it that really pumped me up, and of course Andy Weir," he recalls regarding his portrayal of Science Officer Logan Bowers. "Then when I got the theme, that it was something relevant today and makes you think about computers and technology taking over and making us obsolete. It just hit me in that right zeitgeist, at that right little point."

"As a poor kid, there was no YouTube or cell phones, and we didn’t have computers," reminisces Leguizamo. "I used to go to the Broadcast Museum on 53rd Street and listen to old radio plays like The Shadow and these incredible detective radio plays. It's a different art form. With no visuals, your voice has to create the world. I thought that was an incredible challenge."

DeBose portrays the Wild Blue Yonder's confident First Officer Becca Bang, who’s stranded in a temporal mystery that might engulf her at any moment.

"I've yet to do anything like this, which is always exciting," she adds. "I was a little afraid of it, which told me I should do it. These gents are so talented. It's great company. It’s coming from brilliant minds who build worlds so impeccably. And it's about real stuff we’re dealing with today. I liked the idea that we could tell this story and make people listen and create a space for them to imagine themselves in it and see how they problem-solve to make the world a bit better."

Recording your character's lines is far more difficult than just stepping up to the microphone to read a script, and our ace "Exoplanet" trio delivered in every session.

"I just go in and throw myself at something," DeBose recalls. "I don’t really have a method. But I can tell you this: it is a full-body workout. I use everything at my disposal, whether it’s a chair or a pillow or running in place. I just do what the character does and end up sweating. And after three days, I have to go sit in silence. It's great. I love the idea of bringing back the radio play. The art of listening is such a thing. I don’t think people listen enough. Even for myself."

Likewise, Leguizamo embraced his booth sessions with exuberance and authenticity.

"You have to cancel the rest of your day, especially if you've got to talk, because your vocal chords are fried," he admits. "And if they're not fried you're not doing your job. You really have to do the physicality. If you run you have to run like a maniac and be out of breath. If I'm getting hit I start punching myself. Then there’s a sexiness to doing these things. Your voice has to have a little mystery, a little naughtiness. It’s an interesting intersection where you pull it back a little and invite the audience in.”

For Mackie, who’s used to athleticism needed to play MCU superheroes like The Falcon and Captain America, recording dialogue offered a different type of opportunity.

“I look for reasons not to talk to people, so I love doing these," he jokes. "Once I’m out of the studio, I’m not talking to anybody for two days. At a certain point for me, I find mentally I get tired of hearing myself talk. I just have to come home at cut off. I’ve said enough words for the next month.”

"Exoplanet" is available now exclusively from Audible.

Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.View Deal

]]> <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Nov. 10, 2013: Europe's GOCE satellite, the 'Ferrari of space,' fell out of orbit after mapping Earth's gravity field ]]>

On Nov. 10, 2013, Europe's GOCE satellite fell to Earth after four years in orbit mapping the planet's gravitational field.

GOCE, its name was short for Gravity field and steady-state Ocean Circulation Explorer, launched in 2009 on a mission to map Earth's gravity like never before. But despite that successful mission, it was doomed in 2013 when it ran out of fuel.

At the time, controllers weren't sure where GOCE would fall back to Earth. Some people worried that it might crash into a populated area. However, the small spacecraft broke up in the atmosphere and didn't cause any property damage.

It disintegrated about 50 miles above the Falkland Islands in the South Atlantic Ocean. The European Space Agency called the mission a success. GOCE lasted far longer than expected. It showed small variations in Earth's gravity, mapped the structure of Earth's crust and mantle, and tracked ocean currents.

Why it mattered

The GOCE satellite was a sleek spacecraft, with fins covered in solar panels that gave it a futuristic design. In fact, its look earned it a pretty cool nickname.

"GOCE's sleek, elegant aerodynamic design — responsible for it being dubbed the 'Ferrari of space' — immediately set it apart from most other satellites,." ESA officials said in a description.

There was more than looks behind GOCE's design. In order to generate the best map ever of Earth's gravitational field, GOCE had to fly in an orbit so low — just 139 miles (224 kilometers) — it needed to counteract the drag from the gossamer thin atmosphere of Earth at that altitude. The International Space Station orbits Earth at nearly twice that altitude.

GOCE was powered by an xenon ion engine that allowed to maintain its low orbit for four years. Once it ran out of fuel, the 1-ton satellite could not maintain its position in space, leading to a fiery plunge to Earth.

The large size of GOCE — it weighed 2,425 pounds (1,100 kilograms) and was 17 feet (5.3 meters) long and 3.2 feet (1 m) wide — made its reentry stand out, particularly since at least 25% of the satellite was expected to reach the Earth's surface.

]]> <![CDATA[ A distant exoplanet mysteriously vanished from sight. Astronomers just discovered why ]]> Astronomers have solved the mystery of an extrasolar planet, or exoplanet, that "disappeared" after seven years of observations. New research suggests that the planet hasn't vanished at all, but has been dragged off its orbit by an unseen planet.

The exoplanet, designated TOI-2535 b, is located around 1,000 light-years away. TOI-2535 b was routinely observed with NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) space telescope for seven years between April 2019 and March 2026 as it completed its 8.25-Earth day orbit of its parent star. That's 10 times quicker than the orbit of Mercury around the sun and means this blisteringly hot planet is classed as a "hot Jupiter."

However, something strange happened started to happen as astronomers observed the distant world. The orbits of the planet weren't regular like those of other planets, with TOI-2535 b often arriving six hours early or six hours later than when astronomers expected. Then, in March this year, TESS was no longer spotting the characteristic drops in starlight that TOI-2535 b caused as it crossed, or "transited," the face of its parent star. It seemed to have vanished.

This team used TESS data to determine that TOI-2535 b is being pulled on by an unseen neighbor and is, in turn, pulling on that planet as well. This is causing the orbits of both worlds in the TOI-2535 system to "wobble." TOI-2535 b disappeared when that wobble tilted it out of alignment with its star.

"We think of the universe as resembling clockwork, where everything is regular, but that's not true. If there are multiple planets in a system, they can affect each other's orbits. ]]> <![CDATA[ Uranus has a weird magnetic field that's stumped scientists for 40 years — we may finally know why ]]> The posided magnetic fields of Uranus and Neptune may stem from extreme conditions lying within their deep interior. Unravelling the mystery behind the magnetic fields of these worlds is giving us new insight into the little-known interiors of the ice giants.

Only one spacecraft has ever visited Uranus and Neptune, the Voyager 2 spacecraft which spend past Uranus in January 1986 and Neptune in August 1989. Voyager 2 found that their planetary magnetic fields were, to put it bluntly, wonky. Uranus’ magnetic field was offset from its rotational axis by 59 degrees and isn’t even centered on the planet’s core, but instead is only two-thirds of the way down. Neptune is similar, with a disordered magnetic field offset by 47 degrees and centered halfway between the core and its visible cloud tops.

If we compare these planets to Earth, which has a stable magnetic field tilted by just 11 degrees to our planet’s rotation, we can see how extreme the magnetic fields of the ice giants are.

Various explanations for the strange magnetic fields of the ice giants have been put forward over the years. Uranus as a whole is tilted by 97 degrees and effectively rolls around the sun, and speculation is that billions of years ago it was knocked on its side by a collision with a long-lost Earth-sized planet. Could this collision have also skewed its magnetic field?

This might be a plausible explanation were Neptune’s magnetic field also not similarly skewed without having experienced a collision. Clearly, whatever the cause, it must be intrinsic to the nature of the two ice giant planets. Now, a new study by scientists in the U.S. and the UK, based on computer simulations and Voyager 2’s measurements of the two planets’ magnetic fields, may have found a solution.

The solution to the weird magnetic fields of the solar system's ice giants may come down to how planets generate their magnetic field through the dynamo effect. This arises from the swirling, convective motion of an electrically conducting liquid within a rotating body, which is able to generate and maintain a powerful magnetic field.

Inside Earth, the electrically conducting fluid is the molten iron in the outer part of our planet’s core, and the magnetic field that it generates has clear north and south poles – what we call a dipole, a phenomenon that we can also see in the two magnetic poles of a simple bar magnet.

However, the conditions inside Uranus and Neptune are somewhat different. As ice giants, they contain a lot of volatiles – ammonia, hydrogen, helium, methane, and water surrounding a probable rocky core. Furthermore, Uranus and Neptune are substantially larger than Earth, with 14.5 and 17 times the mass of our planet, respectively. This increased mass creates crushing conditions within the interior of the ice giants.

"Deep inside Uranus and Neptune, pressures and temperatures become extremely high," research team leader Chi Yan of the University of Texas at Austin, who led the new findings, said in a statement. "Under those conditions, which can cause water molecules to break apart into ions, the material may become increasingly electrically conductive with depth."

Given the increasing electrical conductivity and the compositions of the two planets, the computer simulations were able to replicate the bizarre magnetic fields of Uranus and Neptune. This showed how the magnetic-field structure co-evolves alongside changes in the fluid motion driven by convection and the temperature inside the planets.

It also seems that this co-evolution might not yet be over. The simulations indicate that the magnetic fields of both planets can change quite significantly in the space of just a few decades.

"Earth’s magnetic tilt drifts by only a degree or so over 50 years," said Yan. "Our models show the ice giants can behave very differently. In some stretches, the tilt swings by tens of degrees within decades. In others, it shifts only slightly over the same span."

NASA have prioritized a new mission to return to Uranus in the early 2040s, while the China National Space Administration’s Tianwen-4 mission launching to Jupiter in 2029 will deploy a small probe to carry onwards to Uranus via a gravitational slingshot. Until then, scientists are coming up with creative ways to not have to rely only on the 40-year-old Voyager 2 measurements of the magnetic fields.

For example, Tom Stallard of Northumbria University in the UK, who is a co-author with Yan on the new research paper, has been leading James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations of the faint infrared auroral lights on both Uranus and Neptune. Aurorae are generated when charged particles on the solar wind interact with a planet’s magnetic field, driving some of those charged particles into the atmosphere above the magnetic poles. (Neptune actually has a quadrupolar component, muddling its defined north and south magnetic poles.) As such, the location of aurorae is a good indicator of what’s going on with a planet’s magnetic field.

"We are busy working on what’s contained within these observations, but the shape and structure of the aurora, as well as other weird patterns in the ionosphere [upper atmosphere], promise to provide us with a way of understanding how the magnetic fields have changed, [which is] an important stepping stone," said Stallard.

The hope is that by combining JWST’s observations of the aurora with Voyager 2’s magnetic-field measurements and the results of the computer simulations, it will be possible to estimate the configuration of the magnetic fields on Uranus and Neptune today and see how they compare to the 1980s.

This would provide an experimental test to help show whether the new model describing the magnetic fields is on the right track, although we won’t know for sure until a new mission arrives in the ice giants’ backyard.

The findings were described on 3 November in the journal Communications Physics.

]]> <![CDATA[ Were there 'lost cosmonauts' in the early Soviet space program? ]]> In the final weeks of 1960, two young radio enthusiasts were monitoring transmissions from a home-built listening station on a rooftop in Turin, Italy, when the brothers detected something extraordinary: a faint signal that bore the hallmarks of one originating from space. These strange events from November 1960 became the first in a series of alleged radio signal interceptions that would form the basis of an enduring Cold War-era mystery involving so-called "lost cosmonauts" — early Soviet space travelers rumored to have died during secret spaceflight missions before Yuri Gagarin's historic flight the following spring, in April 1961.Today, more than six decades later, the story remains one of the most haunting legends of the Space Age. Were there truly early Soviet space missions — with tragically ill-fated cosmonaut crews — that remain undisclosed to this day?

The peculiar story began in October 1957, as the Italian brothers Achille and Gian Battista Judica-Cordiglia learned, along with the rest of the world, about the Soviet Union's successful launch of Sputnik 1, Earth's first artificial satellite.

Immediately, the two became fascinated with the idea of trying to listen in on signals from such spacecraft and began working to assemble their very own radio tracking station, which they put together mostly from secondhand military surplus equipment. What they couldn't easily find and purchase, the brothers would often assemble themselves. They built an improvised tracking station in an abandoned World War Two bunker, which the brothers dubbed Torre Bert, that eventually became a fully functional radio facility with an antenna they built from salvaged materials like chicken wire and scraps of metal.

Whatever it lacked in aesthetics, the station made up for in functionality, and soon the brothers' amateur efforts reportedly allowed them to successfully intercept transmissions associated with Sputnik 2, the first Soviet spacecraft to carry a living creature into orbit: a dog named Laika, who became a one-way passenger on the mission. Later, the boys also said they were able to track transmissions from America's Explorer 1 satellite.

Some of what the Judica-Cordiglia brothers were able to achieve could be chalked up to being in the right place at the right time. Specifically, their location in northern Italy was advantageous, since it allowed them to monitor signals from Soviet spacecraft passing overhead.

By late November 1960, the Judica-Cordiglia brothers learned of reports from a West German observatory suggesting there may have been an unidentified satellite in orbit, raising an intriguing possibility: could there have been a spacecraft launch that had not been disclosed to the public?

Intrigued, the brothers began spending their evenings at Torre Bert scanning the skies for radio frequencies in search of the alleged mystery object. Eventually, they claimed to have detected a signal that differed significantly from those they had tracked in the past. Unlike the familiar electronic beeps they had intercepted from other satellites, this transmission seemed unmistakable: it was Morse code for SOS.

According to their account, as the pair listened to the alarming transmission, the signal gradually began to fade, raising a disconcerting possibility: what if the spacecraft they were monitoring hadn't merely been traveling through orbit, but had been drifting away from Earth?

If correct, the implications were staggering: the Soviet Union may have launched a secret space mission, but this time with a human cosmonaut on board — and something had gone terribly wrong, ending with a spacecraft and its occupant becoming lost in space.

Significantly, the brothers appear to have reached this conclusion independently, and no verified evidence has ever surfaced establishing that the transmission they claimed to have intercepted originated from a crewed spacecraft, let alone one associated with an unacknowledged Soviet mission that somehow escaped Earth's gravitational influence, with tragic results.

Nonetheless, the brothers' claims would soon help give rise to a disturbing possibility: that there had been unknown "lost" cosmonauts who perished during missions that remained hidden from public knowledge.

Heartbeats and ghostly voices

The alleged distress signal was only the beginning of a series of unsubstantiated claims the Judica-Cordiglia brothers made, and by the first days of February 1961, the amateur radio sleuths would claim to have intercepted another odd signal. This time, the pair claimed to have heard labored breathing coming across the airwaves, and even what resembled the strained moans of a person aboard an orbiting spacecraft.

In an equally eerie recording the brothers produced, what sounded like a rapidly beating human heart could be heard. The brothers shared the recording with Italian cardiologist Achille Dogliotti, whose examination reportedly led him to conclude that the sounds were consistent with strained breathing and an elevated human heartbeat.

With time, more recordings would begin to appear, featuring transmissions the boys believed to be evidence of unsuccessful Soviet missions that preceded the successful spaceflight of Yuri Gagarin, whose 108-minute journey around Earth in 1961 made him the first human to travel into space.

However, what may be the brothers' most controversial claim involved a recording they believed captured the final moments of a female cosmonaut whose ill-fated journey allegedly occurred prior to the historic 1963 spaceflight of Valentina Tereshkova, the first woman to travel into space. However, experts have pointed out that these transmissions do not follow typical military communications protocols, further casting doubt on their legitimacy.

Alleged Soviet surveillance?

As the Judica-Cordiglia brothers' notoriety increased, journalists and curiosity-seekers weren't the only ones whose attention they reportedly began to attract; their activities also allegedly garnered interest from intelligence officials.

In one instance, the brothers claimed a man identifying himself as a Russian reporter had visited them. Shortly thereafter, another individual — this time claiming to be an Italian counterintelligence agent — warned them that the "journalist" who had come to see them was a KGB agent.

The Judica-Cordiglias and their unconventional hobby, it seemed, had now placed them in the crosshairs of Soviet intelligence officials.

An unusual twist in this part of the Italian brothers' story would eventually emerge decades later, when London-based journalist Kris Hollington began reinvestigating their claims for a feature story that appeared in the paranormal-focused magazine Fortean Times. According to Hollington, a former Soviet KGB operative who later served as a Russian ambassador to a European country had reportedly confirmed (on condition of anonymity) that Moscow was indeed interested in the Judica-Cordiglias and their claims.

"Our cosmonauts were warned to be careful what they said while in space after this and we had the brothers followed," the former KGB agent reportedly told Hollington.

Things could have ended tragically for the brothers if it were not for the fame they achieved at the time for their alleged radio interceptions. As the former KGB agent told Hollington, it was believed for a time that the brothers "had to be dealt with — an accident perhaps," although after they appeared on a television program that brought them significant attention, any Soviet plans that would have endangered the brothers became impractical.

"That saved their lives," the former KGB agent reportedly told Hollington, who expressed gratitude for the circumstances that may well have saved the Italian brothers, with the former agent confiding to Hollington that he thought "they were good kids."

Unanswered questions

Of course, the claims of alleged Soviet surveillance are difficult to verify given the anonymity requested by Hollington's source. The same must be said of many of the claims made by the Judica-Cordiglias — even if the brothers were successful in intercepting Soviet transmissions at the time, that alone does not prove that they uncovered evidence of unacknowledged missions during which cosmonauts may have perished.

Some, like spaceflight researcher Sven Grahn, have acknowledged the genuine tracking capabilities the brothers possessed while remaining skeptical of the more sensational "lost cosmonaut" claims, suggesting the brothers might have misinterpreted some of the transmissions they recorded.

"I think that the Judica-Cordiglia brothers did run a tracking station and picked up signals from various spacecraft," Grahn said in an assessment of the brothers and their claims. "However, for some reason they thought that they needed sensational stories [to] maintain their image of a 'hot-shot' operation," he adds. "Once they over-interpreted some receptions and made fantastic claims they were 'trapped' and had to continue to produce sensations."

There is also the possibility that the recordings were hoaxes, of course. Whatever the case, there are no independently verified launch records, authenticated communications, or other evidence from the period that provides additional support for what the brothers claimed to have intercepted.

Something that can be verified, however, is the Soviet Union's well-documented secrecy, adding a further layer of complication to matters. As space historian James Oberg has observed, there are verified instances in which Soviet officials altered photographs and records from the early years of human spaceflight, a fact that has perhaps helped fuel rumors about alleged missing cosmonauts. It is also known that the Soviet space program covered up several deadly disasters, such as a launch pad explosion on Oct. 24, 1960 that killed a high-ranking Soviet military officer and at least 100 others. At the time, Soviet state news outlets reported it as a plane crash.

No verified evidence has emerged to support claims of failed, unacknowledged Soviet crewed spaceflights of the kind described in the lost-cosmonaut legends. Yet the Judica-Cordiglia brothers' accounts have drawn attention for decades and remain among the strangest stories in the lore of the early Space Age — a fact that illustrates humanity's enduring fascination with Cold War mysteries and phenomena that exist beyond Earth.

]]> <![CDATA[ A robot just built a structure autonomously in space for the 1st time ever ]]> A robot just played Tinkertoys in space, assembling the first satellite structure ever made without a human touching the controls.

The DARPA-funded project saw a robotic "truss builder" create a reflective antenna using Kapton film, composite fiber tubes and aluminum joints. The implications are huge for future missions, potentially opening up new possibilities to build — or fix — satellites in the final frontier.

"This is the first time that a structure has been autonomously constructed in space," Sergio Pellegrino, an aerospace and civil engineering professor at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), said in a statement on Nov. 5.

The need for such spacecraft will likely rise substantially in the future, as companies assemble giant megaconstellations for cell-phone communications, AI compute and other purposes. Indeed, the ball is already rolling on such ambitious projects, generating enough hype for space startups around the globe to raise a record $20.8 billion in the third quarter of 2026 alone.

Anything that launches aboard a rocket is limited by the size of that vehicle's fairing — the nose cone that protects payloads during their ride to space. In space, however, the ability to stretch out is practically infinite — after taking into account, of course, engineering and financing constraints.

Assembling structures robotically off Earth could therefore be revolutionary, advocates say. And the recent milestone was a step in that direction.

"This work could be useful not only for astronomy and astrophysics, but also for communications and other areas, such as building very large solar arrays for space solar power," said Pellegrino, who's team leader of the truss-building project, a Caltech demonstration mission called Autonomous In-Space Tensioned Reflector Assembly (ASTRA).

ASTRA built a 1.4-meter-wide (4.5-foot) structure in orbit. That's an impressive achievement, but it just scratches the surface of what DARPA wants to accomplish via a program it calls Novel Orbital and Moon Manufacturing, Materials, and Mass-efficient Design, or NOM4D for short.

"NOM4D's objective is to enable efficient, scalable construction of very large structures in space," NOM4D Program Manager Andrew Detor said in a Nov. 5 DARPA statement.

"By 'very large,' I mean hundreds of meters or kilometers in scale. Nothing approaching that scale can be achieved today," Detor added.

ASTRA was a demonstration, allowing researchers to check boxes and identify obstacles before shooting for a bigger goal. And the team did run into issues — specifically, time limitations, which prevented them from building additional sections of the antenna. Still, the researchers were able to prove out the third phase of a larger DARPA project.

Pellegrino's team completed the two previous phases — defining the mission and testing the hardware in a lab — before shipping the ASTRA payload to the spaceflight company Momentus, Inc. for integration into its Vigoride 7 space tug. Vigoride 7 launched on March 30, along with many other payloads, aboard SpaceX's Transporter-16 rideshare mission.

ASTRA flew with two prebuilt sections of a truss, a robotic "manipulator" and parts to make the rest of the truss in space. In brief communication windows totaling 15 minutes a day, engineers sent up commands and checked in on the robot's progress as it picked up things, readied them in the right spot, and performed construction on an assembly plate.

The team overcame many "little surprises" on the way but were not able to finish the entire truss in time. Still, Pellegrino framed the effort as a success.

"Developing a payload of this complexity on such a short timeline was an enormous undertaking for our small team," he said.

Looking into the future, he is hopeful that robots will be able to build larger telescope mirrors for observatories to peer deeper into space, as well as more advanced structures for radio telescopes to listen for distant signals.

NOM4D is also supporting a project from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, but that one will take place at the International Space Station, focusing on how to harden carbon tubes in orbit.

]]> <![CDATA[ Curiosity Mars rover sizes up new 'Nazca' dig site | Space photo of the day for Nov. 10, 2026 ]]>

NASA's Curiosity Mars rover is sizing up its next dig site on the Red Planet.

The Curiosity team will characterize the surface composition of the Mars site, informally named "Nazca," as thoroughly as possible before drilling into it.

What is it?

Curiosity snapped the close-up image on Oct. 18, 2026, using its Mars Hand Lens Imager (MAHLI). The image shows multiple roughly disk-shaped potential crystal formations at the rover's next drill target.

MAHLI is located on the turret at the end of the rover's robotic arm. It uses an onboard focusing process to make a composite of images of the same target acquired at different positions to focus on multiple features in a single image.

Why is it incredible?

Scientists theorize that the "discs and needles" texture takes its characteristic shape as crystals, or "crystal forms," grow.

The relatively large sizes of the crystal forms at "Nazca" may provide clues about the temperatures at which they grew, as well as information about the abundance of salts and fluids in the area at the time. Complicating this picture, however, is the fact that mineral crystals can be replaced by other minerals after their original crystallization. The new minerals are known as "pseudomorphs," because they have the same shape as the original minerals but not the same composition or molecular structure.

The Curiosity team will characterize the surface composition of Nazca — which shares its name with an ancient South American civilization that's famous for the large designs it etched into the rock and dirt — before drilling begins. The NASA researchers will then be able to compare the deeper composition to the surface-level composition.

 <description>Ministerstvo pro místní rozvoj (MMR) připravilo pilotní program bezúročných půjček na potřebnou akontaci. Mnoho mladých lidí totiž nemá dost peněz na zaplacení části nemovitosti, do které chtějí investovat. Program je zaměřen zejména na regiony, z kterých mladí lidé odcházejí. Proto se do něj dostaly i tři oblasti z Karlovarského kraje, řekl na úterní konferenci Transformace Karlovarského kraje Milan Hladík.</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>Objevili ho náhodou, měl amputované nohy, nemohl mluvit. Díky pomoci se veterán dostal opět mezi lidi</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/den-valecnych-veteranu-2026-vlci-mak-rozhovor_2611110926_ako</link>
 <description>Připomínáme si Den válečných veteránů. Odkazuje na konec první světové války, boje utichly 11. listopadu 1918. Váleční veteráni ale nepatří jen do dávné minulosti, moderní veterány má totiž Česko i v dnešní době. Jaký příběh rezonuje v poslední době? „Nemohl mluvit, měl amputované nohy. Dostala se mu ale pomoc a vytáhli ho na různé akce,“ říká pro Radiožurnál Robert Speychal, šéf odboru pro válečné veterány a válečné hroby ministerstva obrany.</description>

 <description>Podzim a výlovy patří k sobě. Například Vojenské lesy a statky ve středu pořádají výlov v chráněné krajinné oblasti Brdy. Rybáři už od časného rána zatahují sítě v Hořejším Padrťském rybníku.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/nove-osvetleni-ale-i-malo-mist-na-odpocinuti-kladno-dokoncilo-opravy_2611110855_elv</link>
 <description>Kladenský magistrát zmodernizoval autobusové nádraží. Za nové přístřešky s lavičkami, osvětlení i bezplatné parkoviště pro téměř 120 aut zaplatil přes 47 milionů korun. Někteří cestující ale novou podobu nádraží nehodnotí pozitivně. „Je tady málo míst na odpočinutí,“ říká jedna z cestujících.</description>

<item>
 <title>Čtyři polské kilometry trati mezi Libercem a Žitavou lákají zloděje kabelů. Kraj žádá Polsko o pomoc</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/ctyri-kilometry-trati-komplikuji-cestu-mezi-libercem-a-zitavou-kraj-zada-polsko_2611110805_med</link>
 <description>Zpoždění v řádu desítek minut, zrušené spoje i komplikace při přestupech. Provoz na železniční trati mezi Libercem a německou Žitavou opakovaně narušují krádeže a poškozování zabezpečovacích kabelů na polském území. Liberecký kraj se proto obrátil na polské velvyslanectví v Praze. Chce, aby polská strana přijala opatření proti vandalismu a zajistila rychlejší opravy poškozeného zařízení.</description>

 <description>Starostou ústeckého Střekova je Jakub Přibyl z koalice Jedno Ústí, vystřídal Pavla Peterku z hnutí ANO. Koalice Jedno Ústí obsadilo také pětičlennou radu. Ustavující zastupitelstvo provázela debata zastupitelů i občanů o možném rušení městského obvodu. </description>

<item>
 <title>Psychologická pomoc po návratu do civilu. Veteráni se snáz svěří někomu s podobnou zkušeností</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/psychologicka-pomoc-po-navratu-do-civilu-veterani-se-snaz-sveri-nekomu-s_2611111040_lbl</link>
 <description>Návrat do civilu není pro všechny bývalé vojáky snadný. I na jejich podporu upozorňuje Den válečných veteránů. Po odchodu z armády jim může chybět známé prostředí nebo kolegové. Někteří se také potýkají s psychickými problémy, o kterých se jim těžko mluví. Podporu jim v Pardubicích nabízí například organizace Bethany – Dům pomoci, která spolupracuje s Agenturou pro podporu válečných veteránů. </description>

</item>

  <item>
   <title>EET zasáhne i doplňkový prodej: Jak to bude v lednu vypadat, kdo dostane výjimku</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/ekonomika/ekonomika-cesko-eet-leden-2027-start-jak-to-bude-povinnost/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=ekonomika</link>
   <description>Prodej šamponu v kadeřnictví, proteinových tyčinek ve fitness centru nebo olejů v masážním salonu. I na vedlejší příjmy z takového prodeje může od ledna 2027 dopadnout nová elektronická evidence tržeb (EET). Rozhodovat nebude to, zda jde o doplňkový prodej, ale především způsob platby a zákonné výjimky. Podnikatelé se už mohou do EET 2.0 registrovat, první měsíc jejího fungování ale bude pilotní. Deník.cz zjišťoval, co to znamená.</description>
   <pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:00:00 +0100</pubDate>

    <media:description>Elektronická evidence tržeb se má od příštího roku vrátit v upravené podobě. Jejím cílem je podle vlády zlepšit výběr daní a omezit šedou ekonomiku.</media:description>

   <description>Svatomartinské husí hody v restauracích se pro řadu rodin mění v těžko dostupný luxus. Útrata za sváteční oběd se pro čtyřčlennou domácnost snadno vyšplhá na několik tisíc korun. Ušetřit se přitom dají stovky i tisíce – stačí vyměnit návštěvu podniku za domácí pečení, případně sáhnout po dostupnější alternativě v podobě kachny či kuřete.</description>

   <title>Bude Letná referendem o vládě? Vít Rakušan už dnes hostem na Deník.cz</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/debata-denik-cz-vit-rakusan-demonstrace-protest-letna/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=cesko</link>
   <description>Deník.cz pokračuje v pravidelných debatách s předními českými politiky. Dnes bude Kateřina Perknerová v pořadu 15 minut rozmlouvat s předsedou STAN Vítem Rakušanem. Zeptáme se, co hodlá bývalým sympatizantům Andreje Babiše nabídnout a v čem vidí největší slabiny jeho vládnutí. Řeč bude také o státním rozpočtu, České televizi a rozhlasu i o výrocích Petra Macinky. Přímý přenos debaty sledujte od 11:45.</description>

  <item>
   <title>Lidem bez domova dají nocleh a polévku. Jde o první krok na cestě z ulice</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/lidem-bez-domova-daji-nocleh-a-polevku-jde-o-prvni-krok-na-ceste-z-ulice/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=cesko</link>
   <description>V Praze každý večer desítky žen hledají to, co většina lidí považuje za samozřejmost – bezpečné místo ke spánku. Kapacity nocleháren jsou celoročně naplněny, v zimě pak musí vypomoci židle v denních centrech. Za deset let existence projektu Nocleženka veřejnost zakoupila přes 270 tisíc poukazů na přenocování a následnou pomoc, čímž zachránila mnoho životů. Bezdomovectví je podle expertů především systémový problém – bez dostupného bydlení, funkční sociální podpory a kvalitní sociální práce lidé snadno propadají na dno.</description>
   <pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 04:00:00 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/lidem-bez-domova-daji-nocleh-a-polevku-jde-o-prvni-krok-na-ceste-z-ulice/</guid>

   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/0be/0beeb6dc-1370-4457-a47f-1e4104f1e501.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>

    <media:description>Nocleženka jí pomohla dostat se z ulice. Nyní má Alice bydlení i práci. Na její cestě jí pomáhaly sociální pracovnice Armády spásy.</media:description>

   <description>Stačila chvilka nepozornosti a z obyčejného parkování byly hned dvě dopravní nehody. Na Českolipsku se během pondělí odehrály dva podobné karamboly. Oba řidiči totiž místo brzdy sešlápli plynový pedál. Jeden z nich při manévrování v podzemních garážích naboural dvě zaparkovaná auta, druhý skončil s vozem v autobusové zastávce.</description>

      <title>Papeži v Peru před návštěvou odhalili majestátní sochu. Je vysoká 14 metrů</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/papez-navsteva-peru-odhalili-mu-sochu-callao-lima.A261111_094212_zahranicni_ikul#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Papeži Lvovi XIV. odhalili v Peru před jeho středečním příjezdem do země 14 metrů vysokou sochu. Lev XIV. má k Peru hluboký vztah, v zemi strávil několik let jako misionář a později jako biskup. V minulosti obdržel i občanství této země. Peruánci proto papeže narozeného ve Spojených státech považují tak trochu za svého.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Hlavní město povede STAN, SPOLU a Praha sobě. Dopravu má Scheinherr, finance Portlík</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/praha-sobe-koalice-praha-stan-spolu-hlavacek-portlik.A261110_162725_domaci_dyn#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Pět týdnů po volbách zástupci STAN, SPOLU a Prahy sobě oznámili konečnou sestavu koalice pro vedení hlavního města. Podle informací iDNES.cz už jsou křesla rozdělená, na tiskové konferenci to částečně potvrdil i budoucí primátor Petr Hlaváček (STAN). Starostové budou mít primátora a čtyři radní, SPOLU obsadí čtyři křesla a dva posty připadnou Praze sobě. Strany podepíšou koaliční dohodu 18. listopadu.</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:27:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci">Zprávy - Domácí</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/praha-sobe-koalice-praha-stan-spolu-hlavacek-portlik.A261110_162725_domaci_dyn/diskuse</comments>

      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/103/cl6/DYN6cd870699a_122834_17853677.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>V Praze pokračují jednání o složení koalice po volbách. Již potřetí se od voleb setkává vítězné STAN s koalicí SPOLU pro Prahu. (22. října 2026)</media:description>
      <media:credit>MAFRA</media:credit>

      <title>RECENZE: Dorostla do první ligy. Tereza Mašková ukázala, že přišel její čas</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/kultura/hudba/recenze-dorostla-do-prvni-ligy-tereza-maskova-ukazala-ze-prisel-jeji-cas.A261111_015452_hudba_majo#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Své vyprodané turné završila Tereza Mašková v Českých Budějovicích. Zpěvačka s výjimečnými hlasovými a interpretačními kvalitami odehrála v místním Domě kultury Metropol poslední samostatný koncert před chystanou O2 arenou. V doprovodu kapely, smyčcového kvarteta a silných melodií potvrdila, že dorostla do první ligy.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Výbor posuzuje jednotlivé kapitoly návrhu rozpočtu, řeší i sektorové daně</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/rozpocet-vybor-poslanecka-snemovna-schillerova-pikora-dluh-schodek.A261110_210656_domaci_ikro#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Rozpočtový výbor Poslanecké sněmovny ve středu pokračuje v projednávání návrhu státního rozpočtu na příští rok, který počítá se schodkem 386 miliard korun. Poslanci se zaměří na jednotlivé rozpočtové kapitoly a případné úpravy výdajů před druhým čtením návrhu na plénu Sněmovny. Zabývají se také návrhem na zavedení mimořádné daně pro rafinerie.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Pat v Nové Pace. Obě nejsilnější uskupení chtějí svého starostu</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/volby/hradec-kralove/nova-paka-komunalni-volby-starosta-pat-nydrlova-cogan.A261111_984495_hradec-zpravy_tuu#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Měsíc od komunálních voleb stále není jasné, jaké bude složení vedení radnice v Nové Pace na Jičínsku. Na pondělní ustavující schůzi zastupitelé radu ani starostu nezvolili, protože žádná ze stran nepodala návrh. Budou dál jednat. Znovu se zastupitelé sejdou v polovině prosince, do té doby pokračuje stávající vedení města.</description>

      <media:description>Komunální volby v říjnu 2026 vyhrálo uskupení Mladá Paka s advokátkou Nikolou Nydrlovou, získali 9 křesel v jednadvacetičlenném zastupitelstvu.</media:description>

    <item>
      <title>Nova zakáže přetáčení reklam při zpětném sledování. Změna začne platit 18. listopadu</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/mediahub/nova-pretaceni-reklam-zakaz-18-listopadu.A261111_084850_mediahub_jpl#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Od středy 18. listopadu nebude při zpětném sledování volně dostupných programů TV Nova možné přetáčet reklamu. Nova zároveň operátorům nabízí řešení, které by divákům umožnilo reklamní blok po prvních třech minutách přetočit. Podle televize změna pomůže vytvářet podmínky pro další investice do vlastní tvorby.</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/mediahub">Zprávy - Mediahub</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/mediahub/nova-pretaceni-reklam-zakaz-18-listopadu.A261111_084850_mediahub_jpl/diskuse</comments>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">A261111_084850_mediahub_jpl</guid>
      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/24/081/cl6/JPL43a248a45f_Novelogo_Nova.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>Nova slaví 30 let a při této příležitosti představila novou vizuální identitu hlavní stanice TV Nova. Hlavním grafickým prvkem se stává tzv. nekonečná smyčka, která tak nahrazuje dosavadní spirálu a bude se prolínat veškerými vizuálními výstupy televize</media:description>
      <media:credit>TV Nova</media:credit>
    </item>

<title>Nova omezí přetáčení reklam. U některých operátorů poběží celý blok</title>

<description>Od středy 18. listopadu diváci při zpětném sledování šesti stanic Novy přijdou o možnost volně přetáčet reklamu. O tom, zda půjde přeskočit alespoň část bloku, rozhodne způsob, jakým jejich operátor reklamu přehrává.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/otec-meghan-markle-je-opet-ve-vazbe-muz-obvineny-z-drzeni-detske-pornografie-si_2611110837_mst</link>
 <description>Otec britské vévodkyně ze Sussexu Thomas Markle je zpět ve vazbě ve federální věznici na Floridě. Markle je obviněný z držení dětské pornografie. Minulý týden byl po svém zatčení umístěn do domácího vězení, v úterý si ale podle soudu sám odřízl elektronický monitorovací náramek z kotníku. Porušil tak podmínky domácí vazby a soud ho poslal do věznice, píše agentura Reuters.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/ruska-tajna-sluzba-tvrdi-ze-zadrzela-dva-polske-agenty-vini-je-ze-spionaze-v_2611110729_mst</link>
 <description>Ruská tajná služba FSB oznámila zadržení dvou agentů polských zpravodajských služeb, které viní ze špionáže – konkrétně ze shromažďování informací o vojenských objektech a sociálně-ekonomické situaci v ruské Kaliningradské oblasti, která je vklíněná mezi polským a litevským územím. Uvedla to ve středu ráno agentura Interfax. Mluvčí polského ministra odpovědného za tajné služby označil za provokaci a dezinformaci. </description>

 <description>Končícím republikánům v americkém Kongresu zbývá necelých pět jednacích týdnů. Bylo by namístě předpokládat, že strana po historické volební porážce využije zbývající čas k prosazení návrhů, kterými ještě naposledy ovlivní směřování země. Ale zákony, které musejí zákonodárci do konce roku stihnout určitě, se nebezpečně nakupily. Zápas ve Washingtonu se očekává třeba o další financování obrany a války s Íránem.</description>

 <description>Ukrajinské dronové útoky v noci na středu způsobily požár v ruském exportním přístavu Usť-Luga v Baltském moři.  <description>Krakovský střelec, který zabil tři členy své rodiny a šest náhodných kolemjdoucích, se zajímal o norského neonacistického extremistu Anderse Breivika. V úterý to podle agentury PAP řekl ministr spravedlnosti Waldemar Žurek. Podle něj i další zajištěné důkazy poukazují na to, že střelec mohl mít názorově blízko ke krajní pravici.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-v-abu-zabi-se-jednalo-o-vymene-zajatcu-a-navratu-ukrajinskych-deti-rika_2611101647_jar</link>
 <description>Zástupci Ukrajiny, Ruska a USA při úterních třístranných jednáních v Abú Zabí diskutovali o výměnách zajatců a návratu ukrajinských dětí do vlasti, uvedl v úterý ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj při návštěvě Dánska. Podle agentury Reuters oznámil, že kromě humanitárních problémů strany diskutovaly také o bezpečnostních zárukách. Trilaterální jednání o válce na Ukrajině začalo v Abú Zabí v úterý a má pokračovat ve středu.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/politicka-show-porazeneho-kongresmana-nazval-hegseth-snahu-podat-proti-nemu_2611101520_zko</link>
 <description>Americký ministr obrany Pete Hegseth označil snahu o podání ústavní žaloby na svou osobu kvůli válce v Íránu za politické divadlo, které selže. Nepřátelům Spojených států podle jeho názoru takové úsilí ukazuje, že země je ochotná trestat své vlastní bojovníky a vedení za zákonné vojenské operace. Republikánský kongresman Thomas Massie v pondělí ve Sněmovně reprezentantů představil návrh na impeachment, neboli ústavní žalobu, na Hegsetha.</description>

<description>Kanadská AI společnost Cohere dokončila akvizici pražského kyberbezpečnostního startupu Aisle, za nímž stojí Ondřej Vlček, Stanislav Fort a Jaya Baloo. Vlček to oznámil na LinkedInu. <description>Česká národní banka (ČNB) otestovala obchodování s vlastními dluhopisy prostřednictvím technologie, která je spojená předev&#353;ím s bitcoinem a dal&#353;ími kryptoměnami. Využila systém distribuovaného registru (DLT) k vydání a převodům běžných korunových dluhopisů v digitální podobě, kde má dluhopis podobu digitálního tokenu. Podle guvernéra ČNB Ale&#353;e Michla je DLT &#8222;možnou platformou budoucnosti&#8220;.</description>

Klub SLK vybral jako jeho nástupce poslance a bývalého náměstka Jana Svitáka. Ten kvůli nové roli odejde z Poslanecké sněmovny. Volba proběhne 15. prosince.</description></item><item><title>Silnici 13 u Jítravy zablokovala nehoda tří aut. Jeden zraněný</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905474-silnici-13-u-jitravy-zablokovala-nehoda-tri-aut-jeden-zraneny.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905474-silnici-13-u-jitravy-zablokovala-nehoda-tri-aut-jeden-zraneny.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:45:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Srážka tří aut ráno zablokovala silnici mezi Bílým Kostelem a Jítravou. Silnice byla nějakou dobu zcela uzavřená, poté policisté až do ukončení zásahu řídili dopravu kyvadlově. Při nehodě se zranil jeden člověk.</description></item><item><title>Liberecký cykloboom: Počet výpůjček sdílených kol vzrostl letos na dvojnásobek</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905448-liberecky-cyklobom-pocet-vypujcek-sdilenych-kol-vzrostl-letos-na-dvojnasobek.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905448-liberecky-cyklobom-pocet-vypujcek-sdilenych-kol-vzrostl-letos-na-dvojnasobek.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:59:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Letošní sezóna sdílených kol v Liberci překonala všechna očekávání. Od dubna do října lidé uskutečnili 38 465 jízd, což je více než dvojnásobek oproti loňsku. S nárůstem o 103 % vykazuje Liberec druhý nejrychlejší růst cyklomobility v ČR a vyvrací mýtus, že je město pro kola příliš kopcovité.</description></item><item><title>Stovky litrů vody za sekundu navíc: Přehrada Josefův Důl znásobí své síly</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905356-stovky-litru-vody-za-sekundu-navic-prehrada-josefuv-dul-znasobi-sve-sily.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905356-stovky-litru-vody-za-sekundu-navic-prehrada-josefuv-dul-znasobi-sve-sily.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Nov 2026 06:30:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vydatné deště a tání sněhu už nepřijdou vniveč. Přehrada Josefův Důl brzy dostane z Jeleního potoka až půl kubíku vody za sekundu navíc. Trubka pod zemí tak zajistí plné kohoutky na Liberecku i Jablonecku, a navíc bude pohánět novou elektrárnu, která vyrobí čistou energii.</description></item><item><title>Chodkyně zemřela v Hejnicích po střetu s osobním autem</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905456-chodkyne-zemrela-v-hejnicich-na-liberecku-po-stretu-s-osobnim-autem.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905456-chodkyne-zemrela-v-hejnicich-na-liberecku-po-stretu-s-osobnim-autem.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 20:42:13 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Chodkyně zemřela v úterý v podvečer v Hejnicích po střetu s osobním autem. Tragická nehoda se stala na přechodu pro chodce v Lázeňské ulici, řekli regionální mluvčí policie a záchranné služby.</description></item><item><title>V libereckém Vesci shořelo auto</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905452-v-libereckem-vesci-shorelo-auto.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905452-v-libereckem-vesci-shorelo-auto.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 19:45:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Hasiči z Liberce vyrazili v úterý dopoledne k požáru osobního auta do čtvrti Vesec. Navíc hrozilo, že se oheň rozšíří na blízké budovy.</description></item><item><title>110 km/h v obci a propadlý řidičák. Hazardér v mercedesu byl rekordmanem kontrol</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905409-110-km-h-v-obci-a-propadly-ridicak-hazarder-v-mercedesu-byl-rekordmanem-kontrol.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905409-110-km-h-v-obci-a-propadly-ridicak-hazarder-v-mercedesu-byl-rekordmanem-kontrol.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 19:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Při dopravní kontrole v Libereckém kraji odhalili policisté 49 řidičů porušujících rychlostní limity. Dva z nich jeli o 60 km/h rychleji – v obci Držkov naměřili řidiči mercedesu 110 km/h a navíc zjistili propadlý řidičák. Akce odhalila i jízdu bez pásů, s mobilem, pod vlivem drog či přes zákaz.</description></item><item><title>V Libereckém kraji přibylo dalších 30 km silnic, kde se bude v zimě solit</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905299-v-libereckem-kraji-pribylo-dalsich-30-km-silnic-kde-se-bude-v-zime-solit.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905299-v-libereckem-kraji-pribylo-dalsich-30-km-silnic-kde-se-bude-v-zime-solit.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 18:08:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>V Libereckém kraji přibylo dalších 30 kilometrů silnic druhých a třetích tříd, kde se bude v zimě solit. Chemicky tak bude krajská společnost Silnice LK udržovat 1080 kilometrů, což je přes 52 procent krajských komunikací. Ne všude je v Libereckém kraji možné solit.</description></item><item><title>Bunkr pro stíhačky i socha s tajemstvím: Liberecký kraj má pět nových památek</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905404-bunkr-pro-stihacky-i-socha-s-tajemstvim-liberecky-kraj-ma-pet-novych-pamatek.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905404-bunkr-pro-stihacky-i-socha-s-tajemstvim-liberecky-kraj-ma-pet-novych-pamatek.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Památkový fond Libereckého kraje se v roce 2026 rozrostl o pět pozoruhodných přírůstků. Mezi nově chráněné kulturní památky patří betonový úkryt pro stíhačky na Mimoňsku, putovní socha Osvobození v Liberci, historická usedlost, starý mlýn na Frýdlantsku a Husův sbor v Turnově.</description></item><item><title>Významné výročí. Fotbal v Českém Dubu slaví sto let</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905388-vyznamne-vyroci-fotbal-v-ceskem-dubu-slavi-sto-let.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905388-vyznamne-vyroci-fotbal-v-ceskem-dubu-slavi-sto-let.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:45:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Fotbal</category><description>Sto let organizovaného fotbalu v Českém Dubu si v sobotu 14. listopadu od 14 hodin v prostorách České besedy připomenou bývalí hráči, trenéři, funkcionáři i fanoušci.</description></item></channel></rss>

výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu dobrý den ze šluknovského výběžku, konce světa - šluknovský výběžek Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:57 +0000 cs hourly 1 https://wordpress.org/?v=7.1.4 https://www.vybezek.eu/wp-uploads/2018/09/cropped-favicon-vybezek-32x32.png výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu 32 32 Vítr z hor – Tobias Piero Dohm: RAUM – ZEIT https://www.vybezek.eu/296639-vitr-z-hor-tobias-piero-dohm-raum-zeit/ Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:57 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296639 V pondělí 9. listopadu 2026 byl zahájen letošní ročník divadelního festivalu Vítr z hor, jako první se představil performer Tobias Piero Dohm v představení RAUM – ZEIT.

Z anotací – Festival Vítr z hor se i letos připojuje k mezinárodní akci La Nuit du Cirque, a přináší do Šluknovského výběžku cirkusový vír fantazie, odvahy a hravosti. A co vás čeká?

Kromě tří dnů Cirkusových nocí 13. – 15. 11. i dvě další novocirkusová představení 9. a 12. listopadu! Nenechte si je ujít! V pondělí 9. 11. 2026 Tobias Piero Dohm (@pieroodo): Raum Zeit. Vizuálně působivá inscenace, v níž se pohybem, objekty a proměnlivým prostorem posouvají hranice mezi tělem, prostředím a časem.

Tma, kouř, koule. Koule skoro všude. A písek…

]]> Festival rostlin v České Kamenici https://www.vybezek.eu/296611-festival-rostlin-v-ceske-kamenici/ Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:26:06 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296611 V sobotu 7. a neděli 8. listopadu 2026 se ve sportovní hale v České Kamenici koná Festival rostlin.

Akce, která pokud vím, tu dosud neměla obdoby. Celá hala plná několika řad regálů a na nich kytky, spousty kytek. Mnohdy takových, jaké jste ještě nejspíš ani neviděli… A davy, odnášející si mnohdy nejednu plnou tašku. Neuvěřitelný výběr. Plus nějaké doplňky.

Pro mne zjištění, že jsem uvázl v minulosti a jsem mimo nejen v náhledu na ceny v restauracích, ale zaspal jsem i cenový vývoj u pokojovek. Vlastně hrůza, jak velké jmění mi za pár let doma různě uschlo…

]]> Parní vlak na trase Drážďany – Moldava a zpět 07. 11. 2026 https://www.vybezek.eu/296569-parni-vlak-na-trase-drazdany-moldava-a-zpet-07-11-2026/ Sat, 07 Nov 2026 13:57:39 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296569 V sobotu 7. listopadu 2026 za hojného zájmu přihlížejících dětí, dospělých i šotoušů zastavila na vlakovém nádraží v Rumburku zase jednou souprava tažená parní lokomotivou (35 1097).

Žst. Rumburk:

Moldavská dráha / Teplický Semmering / „Most – Freiberg“ na FB:

V SOBOTU 7. LISTOPADU VYRAZÍ Z DRÁŽĎAN PARNÍ VLAK NA MOLDAVU!

Železniční muzeum Dresden-Altstadt a spolek Flügelradtouristik pořádají mimořádnou jízdu historického vlaku s oddílovými osobními vozy a jídelním vozem.

Z Drážďan vyrazí v 6:30 s německou parní lokomotivou 35 1097 přes Rumburk a Děčín do Mostu. Zde převezme vlak česká parní lokomotiva 433.001 „Skaličák“, které bude na horské trati pomáhat dieselová lokomotiva.

Most 12:00 – Osek město 12:32 – Dubí 13:22 – Moldava 14:09. Zpět z Moldavy vlak odjede v 15:20 přes Dubí, Louku u Litvínova a Teplice do Drážďan. Část historické soupravy zamíří také do Žatce, města chmele a piva.

Souprava na nádraží doplnila vodu (výpomoc poskytly dva vozy JSDH Brtníky), a posádka provedla na mašině nutný servis (trochu mne zaskočily dva pytle písku, ale má to logické vysvětlení).

Na FB Děčínsko video a info:

Parní vlak v čele s německou lokomotivou 35 1097-1 (vyrobenou v roce 1959 a známou také pod přezdívkou Rübezahl) projel v sobotu dopoledne těsně před desátou hodinou po železničním mostě mezi Děčínem východ a hlavním nádražím. Pohled na tuto historickou soupravu z nové lávky pro pěší a cyklisty.

]]> Sportovní hry mládeže Varnsdorf 2026/2027 – futsal https://www.vybezek.eu/296466-sportovni-hry-mladeze-varnsdorf-2026-2027-futsal/ Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:31:16 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296466 Ve čtvrtek 5. listopadu 2026 pokračovaly aktuální Sportovní hry mládeže 2026/2027 ve sportovní hale ve Varnsdorfu futsalem.

Po „loňské“ premiéře opakování nové disciplíny.





Prozatímní výsledky škol:


Ze sociálních sítí:

TOS VDF:

Třetí místo ve futsale vybojovala naše školní reprezentace v dalším dílu seriálu Sportovních her mládeže.

Ve skupině jsme nejprve porazili pozdějšího vítěze, rumburskou obchodku 2:1, když naše góly zařídili Hlavsa a Průša. Poté jsme přesvědčivě zválcovali Mariánskou poměrem 5:0. Trefili se dvakrát Jirků a Hejtmánek, svůj druhý gól v turnaji vsítil také Hlavsa. V posledním zápase nám do finále stačil bod, ovšem trápení v zakončení nebralo konce, a tak jsme s rumburským gymnáziem prohráli 0:2. Čekal nás souboj o bronz s Karolínou Světlou.

V zápase jsme vedli díky dalekonosné střele brankáře Veroňka, avšak Karolínka rychle otočila. V posledních vteřinách nás zachránil Průša a šlo se do penalt. Až v šesté sérii soupeř penaltu neproměnil a naši šestou v řadě dal s přehledem Škvrna.

Děkujeme za vzornou reprezentaci školy této sestavě: Veroněk – Švihlík, Jirků, Průša, Hlavsa, Hejtmánek, Margala, Škvrna.

Střední zdravotnická škola a Obchodní akademie Rumburk na FB:

Futsalový turnaj a skvělé výsledky našich týmů! Včera naši kluci vybojovali 1. místo z 9 mužstev a holky obsadily krásné 2. místo z 5 týmů! Oběma týmům gratulujeme a děkujeme za skvělou reprezentaci naší školy!

Další disciplínou bude šplh v pátek 4. 12. 2026 v tělocvičně gymnázia Rumburk.
